patch_description:
Replace the clipped concentric-ring arrangement with a feasible layered near-hexagonal seed and a deterministic constrained nonlinear refinement. The seed uses alternating rows of five and six circles, with larger circles in the less crowded rows and smaller circles in the six-circle rows. This already avoids the severe boundary clipping and coincident outer-circle failures of the old constructor.

The refinement directly maximizes the sum of the 26 independent radii subject to all four wall constraints per circle and all pairwise non-overlap constraints. Supplying analytic constraint Jacobians makes SLSQP practical for this relatively small 78-variable problem. A final uniform safety scaling is applied from the exact geometric clearances, ensuring that tiny optimizer feasibility tolerances can never create an invalid output. If SciPy is unavailable or optimization fails, the valid layered seed is returned.
